ImageDescription.value: Heriot-Watt weather station, Cairn Gorm summit Taken on a maintenance visit during a very cold spell in January 1982. The summit temperature was -10 C, but temperatures in the glens went down to below -20 C over the next few nights with strong temperature inversion, very little wind and superb visibility on the tops.

14488839.title: File:Summit radio relay hut, Cairn Gorm - geograph.org.uk - 1754595.jpg

ObjectName.value: Summit radio relay hut, Cairn Gorm - geograph.org.uk - 1754595

Categories.value: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland|Information field template with formatting|Images by Jim Barton|United Kingdom photographs taken on 1981-09-30|Cairn Gorm weather station

ImageDescription.value: Summit radio relay hut, Cairn Gorm I had the privilege of holding a key to the hut while I worked on the Heriot-Watt weather station project in the late 1970s - '80s. It was built to maintain radio contact with mountain rescue teams working in areas of radio 'shadow' beyond the summit; a supply cable from the ski area connects with mains electrical power. Note the shovel - necessary equipment to gain access to the door in winter.

14488844.title: File:Summit weather station and hut, Cairn Gorm - geograph.org.uk - 1754586.jpg

ObjectName.value: Summit weather station and hut, Cairn Gorm - geograph.org.uk - 1754586

Categories.value: Images from Geograph Britain and Ireland|Information field template with formatting|Images by Jim Barton|United Kingdom photographs taken on 1982-01-06|Cairn Gorm weather station

ImageDescription.value:
Summit weather station and hut, Cairn Gorm Closing up the hut at 3 pm after a maintenance visit, with the station still operating. My notes for the day record that I removed half a metre of rime from the radio aerials, replaced the wind vane, did sundry electronics jobs and saw a white hare about 500m away.
Four days later as the cold settled weather continued, the temperature at Braemar fell to -27.2 C, equalling the previous UK lowest minimum, also recorded at Braemar on 11th February 1895.

ImageDescription.value: Maintenance in progress, Cairn Gorm weather station. Maintenance work on the station could be likened to servicing a washing machine inside a large draughty freezer. Here there has been a big build-up of about 2 metres of rime on the right-hand radio aerial mast, and the whole hut is plastered in snow-ice. For a snow-free view taken in the same year, see 381777.
